note: The two sets are nearly identical; Set A includes one additional claim that Set B omits: the (1) 2-1/4" heavy hex nut at the pin connection, which the text layer supports. All other claims match exactly, including shared duplicates (neoprene pad, PL3 1/2X3 1/2X1/4, steel rod, C3X6, W8X10, HSS stated twice) and one shared misbinding: the 12" figure is the maximum elevation difference the rod accommodates, not the rod's length. Both sets also leave out several dimensioned items on the page (3/4" dia A325 bolt, 11" and 28" dia x1/2" plates, 4x4 teflon plate with 2 5/16" hole, PL3-1/2X3-1/2X1 with 2 1/4" dia threaded hole, 3/4" and 3/8" plates, keeper plate). Set A is therefore marginally better for one more correct, non-duplicated claim.
remarks: Both extractions repeat the same facts under two names (e.g. 'C3X6 | section' and 'Channel | section'; 'W8X10 | section' and 'beam | section'; 'HSS | size' and 'HSS4X4X1/4 | wall thickness'; neoprene pad thickness in both " and in). The 'threaded rod | length | up to 12 in' claim in both sets misreads 'UP TO 12" ELEVATION DIFFERENCE' as a length. Entities like 'plate' and 'beam' are generic where the page gives specific designations. Both sets under-cover the footing/pin-connection details despite those being prominent on the page.
